metadata.notes: Folleto domestico estadounidense de 1893, dirigido a la 'duena de casa victoriana' que recibia a los amigos de su marido. Combina dos partes equilibradas: por un lado bebidas para servir (Moselle Cup, Claret Cup, Tom and Jerry, Hot Scotch, Hot After Dinner Liqueur, Kentucky Toddy a la J. M. B., Mint Julep, Sherry Cobbler, Lemonade, Soda Lemonade, Iced Tea, Iced Coffee, Chocolate Glace, Cup of Chocolate); por otro una seleccion de sandwiches finos (Caviare, Anchovie au Naturel, Sardine, Oyster Crab, Salmon, Botargo, Egg Mayonnaise, Egg & Cheese, Deviled Egg, Egg & Mushroom, Aubergine, Pompadour, Lamb con alcaparras, Hot Broiled Ham, Deviled Ham, Chicken Mayonnaise, Breast of Woodcock, Pate de Foie Gras, quesos Roquefort/Brie/Neufchatel/Camembert). Refleja el estilo de los recetarios femeninos de finales del siglo XIX previos a la Cocktail Era estadounidense. Saltadas (no son recetas reales): ON THE (Fragmento OCR de un encabezado); No. 2. ingredients.notes: disueltos en un poco de agua

recipes.method_original: Dissolve in a little water three lumps of loaf sugar; slice into this one orange, one lime and one banana. Add one liqueur glass of Medford rum and one quart of Moselle wine. Pour into your pitcher over the ice. When thoroughly chilled add twelve brandied cherries and one bottle plain soda.
recipes.method_es: Disolver en un poco de agua tres terrones de azucar; cortar en rodajas dentro de esta mezcla una naranja, una lima y un platano. Anadir una copa de licor de ron Medford y un cuarto de galon de vino del Mosela. Verter en la jarra sobre el hielo. Cuando este bien frio anadir doce cerezas al brandy y una botella de soda natural.
recipes.raw_text:
MOSELLE CUP.
Dissolve in a    little    water three lumps of loaf
sugar; slice into this one orange, one lime and one

banana.    Add one liqueur glass of Medford rum and
one quart of Moselle wine.            Pour into your pitcher
over the   ice.   When thoroughly chilled add twelve
brandied cherries and one bo.ttle plain soda.

ingredients.notes: disueltos en un poco de agua
en la parte superior de la jarra

recipes.method_original: Same as above, substituting a bunch of mint in the top of the pitcher for the brandied cherries, and leaving out the banana. A few fresh strawberries are a great addition to this cup. It is a good plan to crush a few leaves of mint with the sugar in any cup where a bunch of mint would be used.
recipes.method_es: Igual que el anterior, pero sustituyendo las cerezas al brandy por un ramillete de menta en la parte superior de la jarra, y omitiendo el platano. Unas fresas frescas son una gran adicion a este cup. Es buena idea machacar unas hojas de menta con el azucar en cualquier cup donde se utilice un ramillete de menta.
recipes.garnish: ramillete de menta y fresas frescas
recipes.raw_text:
MOSELLE CUP No. 2.
Same as above, substituting a bunch of mint in
the top of the pitcher for the brandied cherries,          and
leaving out the banana.             A few fresh strawberries
are a great addition to this cup.           It is a good   plan
to crush a few leaves of       mint with the sugar in any
cup where a bunch of mint would be used.

ingredients.notes: disueltos en un poco de agua
tallos hacia abajo en la parte superior

recipes.method_original: Dissolve in a little water six lumps of loaf sugar; add to this one sliced orange, one sliced lime, the juice of one lemon, one liqueur glass of Medford rum, and one quart of St. Julien claret. Pour into your claret pitcher in which has been previously placed ice and the paring of one cucumber. Stir well and after a few moments remove the cucumber paring. Lastly, add one bottle of plain soda. Place a bunch of mint in the top of the pitcher, stems down, and serve.
recipes.method_es: Disolver en un poco de agua seis terrones de azucar; anadir una naranja en rodajas, una lima en rodajas, el zumo de un limon, una copa de licor de ron Medford y un cuarto de galon de clarete St. Julien. Verter en la jarra de clarete en la que previamente se han colocado hielo y la piel de un pepino. Remover bien y, tras unos minutos, retirar la piel del pepino. Por ultimo, anadir una botella de soda natural. Colocar un ramillete de menta en la parte superior de la jarra, con los tallos hacia abajo, y servir.

ingredients.notes: frotados sobre la piel de un limon fresco para absorber el aceite

recipes.method_original: Rub well four lumps of sugar over the outside of a fresh lemon to absorb the oil. Throw these into a pitcher and pour over them four sherry glasses of best Scotch whiskey. Light this and stir constantly until it burns out. Add six sherry glasses of freshly boiling water and serve at once in four tumblers. This is genuine hot scotch.
recipes.method_es: Frotar bien cuatro terrones de azucar sobre la piel de un limon fresco para absorber el aceite. Echarlos en una jarra y verter encima cuatro copas de jerez del mejor whisky escoces. Prender fuego y remover constantemente hasta que se apague. Anadir seis copas de jerez de agua recien hervida y servir inmediatamente en cuatro vasos tumbler. Este es un autentico hot scotch.
recipes.raw_text:
HOT SCOTCH.
Rub well four lumps of sugar over the Outside
of   a fresh lemon to absorb the oil.  Throw these
into a pitcher and pour over them four sherry glasses

of best Scotch whiskey.        Light this and stir constantly
until it burns out.    Add six sherry glasses of freshly
boiling water and serve at once in four tumblers.

This is genuine hot scotch.

recipes.name_es: Licor caliente para despues de cenar

ingredients.notes: una y media copa de jerez

recipes.method_original: Seven liqueur glasses of brandy, one and one-half sherry wine glasses Jamaica rum, eight lumps of sugar, one handful of browned coffee, one-half a handful of broken stick cinnamon. Put all in a bowl together. Mix well. Light and serve hot in small glasses.
recipes.method_es: Coloca en un bol siete copas de licor de brandy, una y media copa de jerez de ron de Jamaica, ocho terrones de azucar, un punado de granos de cafe tostado y medio punado de canela en rama troceada. Mezcla bien. Flambea y sirve caliente en copitas.
recipes.raw_text:

sherry wine      glasses    Jamaica ram, eight lumps             of

handful of broken          stick    cinnamon.      Put   all   in a

                                   23
recipes.notes: Digestivo flambeado al estilo cafe brulot, aromatizado con cafe y canela; servir caliente en copitas pequenas tras la cena.

recipes.name_original: KENTUCKY TODDY A LA J. M. B.
recipes.name_es: Toddy de Kentucky a la J. M. B.

ingredients.notes: lo minimo para disolver el azucar

recipes.method_original: One lump of loaf sugar dissolved in as little water as possible. Crush into this a small bunch of mint with small lumps of ice. Add bourbon whiskey to suit the taste, stir well and drink.
recipes.method_es: Disuelve un terron de azucar en la minima cantidad de agua posible. Macera en el liquido un ramillete pequeno de menta junto con unos trocitos de hielo. Anade bourbon al gusto, remueve bien y bebe.
recipes.raw_text:
KENTUCKY TODDY A LA J. M. B.
One lump of          loaf   sugar dissolved in as              little

water as possible.            Crush into         this a      small bunch
of    mint with small lumps                of    ice.    Add bourbon
whiskey       to suit the taste,         stir   well    and drink.
recipes.notes: Toddy frio estilo Kentucky con menta machacada, predecesor cercano del mint julep.

ingredients.notes: tres o cuatro, si es temporada

recipes.method_original: Crush a few sprigs of fresh mint with a teaspoonful of sugar. Dissolve in three liqueur glasses of water. Add three liqueur glasses of whiskey or brandy; nearly fill the glass with pounded ice; stir well; place a small bunch of mint, stems down, in the top of the glass and serve with two straws. If strawberries are in season add three or four.
recipes.method_es: Macera unas ramitas de menta fresca con una cucharadita de azucar. Disuelve en tres copas de licor de agua. Anade tres copas de licor de whisky o brandy y casi llena el vaso con hielo picado. Remueve bien, coloca encima un ramillete de menta con los tallos hacia abajo y sirve con dos pajitas. Si es temporada de fresas, anade tres o cuatro.
recipes.garnish: ramillete de menta fresca y, opcionalmente, fresas
recipes.raw_text:
MINT JULEP.
Crush a few sprigs of fresh mint with a teaspoon-
ful   of    sugar.    Dissolve in three liqueur glasses of
water.       Add     three    liqueur glasses           of   whiskey or
brandy; nearly fill the glass with pounded                      ice;    stir

well;      place a small bunch of mint, stems down, in
the top of the glass and serve with two straws.                           If

strawberries are in season add three or four.
recipes.notes: Julep clasico americano con menta machacada y hielo picado; admite whisky o brandy.

recipes.method_original: Put four tablespoonfuls of sherry into a tumbler with half a tablespoonful of sugar; two thin slices of orange and one of lemon. Nearly fill up the glass with pounded ice. Fit your shaker firmly over the glass, and shake well. Add any of the small fruits of the season for a garnish. Serve with two straws. If small fruits are not in season use candied cherries.
recipes.method_es: En un vaso, anade cuatro cucharadas de jerez, media cucharada de azucar, dos rodajas finas de naranja y una de limon. Casi llena el vaso con hielo picado. Encaja firmemente la coctelera sobre el vaso y agita bien. Decora con frutas pequenas de temporada o, en su defecto, cerezas confitadas. Sirve con dos pajitas.
recipes.garnish: frutas pequenas de temporada o cerezas confitadas
recipes.raw_text:
SHERRY COBBLER.
Put four tablespoonfuls of sherry into a tumbler
with half a tablespoonful of sugar; two thin slices of
orange and one of lemon.          Nearly fill up the glass
with pounded      ice.   Fit your shaker firmly over the

glass,   and shake well.    Add any of the small fruits
of the season for a garnish.      Serve with two straws.
If   small fruits are not in season use candied cherries.
recipes.notes: Cobbler clasico de jerez del siglo XIX con citricos y hielo picado, agitado directamente con la coctelera sobre el vaso.

ingredients.notes: lo minimo para disolver el azucar, mas tres pintas para diluir

recipes.method_original: Dissolve fifteen lumps of loaf sugar in as little water as possible. Add the juice of six large fresh lemons, one liqueur glass of Medford rum and three pints of water. Serve in glass pitcher in which have plenty of ice. This will serve six persons.
recipes.method_es: Disuelve quince terrones de azucar en la minima cantidad de agua posible. Anade el zumo de seis limones grandes frescos, una copa de licor de ron Medford y tres pintas de agua. Sirve en una jarra de cristal con abundante hielo. Rinde para seis personas.
recipes.raw_text:
LEMONADE.
Dissolve fifteen lumps of loaf sugar in as                   little

water as possible.           Add the juice of six large fresh
lemons, one liqueur glass of Medford rum and three
pints of water.         Serve in glass pitcher in which have
plenty of ice.      This will serve six persons.
recipes.notes: Limonada de la casa con un toque de ron Medford; sirvela bien fria en jarra para compartir.

ingredients.notes: muy poca, solo para disolver el azucar

recipes.method_original: Dissolve in a very little water about fifteen lumps of loaf sugar. Add the juice of six nice lemons. Pour into glass pitcher over ice. Slice in one large lemon and then add four bottles of plain soda.
recipes.method_es: Disuelve en muy poca agua unos quince terrones de azucar. Anade el zumo de seis limones bonitos. Vierte la mezcla en una jarra de cristal sobre hielo. Anade un limon grande en rodajas y, por ultimo, cuatro botellas de soda natural.
recipes.raw_text:
SODA LEMONADE.
Dissolve      in    a   very    little   water   about   fifteen

lumps of    loaf    sugar.          Add   the juice    of   six   nice
lemons.    Pour into glass pitcher over ice. slice in one
large lemon and then add four bottles of plain soda.
recipes.notes: Limonada gasificada estilo de la epoca; sin alcohol, ideal para temperance entertainments.

ingredients.notes: un poco para disolver el azucar

ingredients.item_es: te Oolong recien hecho y cargado

recipes.method_original: Dissolve four lumps of sugar in a little water. Squeeze in the juice of two lemons. Add one quart of freshly made strong Oolong tea. Fill the pitcher with ice and serve in glasses having a thin slice of lemon in each glass.
recipes.method_es: Disuelve cuatro terrones de azucar en un poco de agua. Anade el zumo de dos limones. Incorpora un cuarto de galon de te Oolong recien hecho y bien cargado. Rellena la jarra con hielo y sirve en vasos con una rodaja fina de limon en cada uno.
recipes.glassware: jarra de cristal y vaso alto
recipes.raw_text:
ICED TEA.
Dissolve four lumps of sugar in a           little      water.

Squeeze in the juice of two lemons.             Add one quart
of freshly made strong Oolong tea.             Fill the pitcher

with ice and serve in glasses having a thin slice of
lemon      in   each glass.
recipes.notes: Te helado clasico al estilo Oolong, endulzado y con limon.

recipes.method_original: Into one quart of boiling milk stir six large tablespoonfuls of ground Mocha coffee. Sweeten to taste. Let boil gently for ten minutes. Strain through flannel bag, and when cold add one-half pint of cream, whipped to a froth. Pour over ice and stir vigorously. Serve in glasses. If desired glace proceed as with chocolate glace.
recipes.method_es: En un cuarto de galon de leche hirviendo, incorpora seis cucharadas grandes de cafe Mocha molido. Endulza al gusto. Deja hervir suavemente diez minutos. Cuela a traves de una bolsa de franela y, cuando este frio, anade media pinta de nata montada a punto de espuma. Vierte sobre hielo y remueve con energia. Sirve en vasos. Si lo deseas glace, procede igual que con el chocolate glace.
recipes.raw_text:
ICED COFFEE.
Into one quart of          boiling milk      stir    six    large

tablespoonfuls of ground          Mocha coffee.       Sweeten to
taste.       Let boil gently for ten       minutes.              Strain

through flannel bag,          and when cold add one-half
pint of cream,         whipped   to a froth.    Pour over ice
and   stir      vigorously.    Serve in glasses.          If   desired

recipes.notes: Cafe helado al estilo de fines del siglo XIX, infusionado en leche y enriquecido con nata montada.

ingredients.item_original: cream, whipped to a stiff froth

recipes.method_original: Break three-quarters of a pound of "Chocolat Menier" (green wrapper) into a large, deep soup plate. Set in the oven, with the door open. In a short time it will melt into a smooth paste, which will dissolve easily in the milk, when added. Place on the fire in an earthen vessel three pints of rich milk. When at the boiling point, add gradually the melted chocolate. Allow to boil about five minutes, stirring constantly with a wooden spoon, from the moment you begin adding the chocolate. Now remove from the fire and when partly cool, add two tablespoonfuls of brandy, and one pint of cream, previously whipped to a stiff froth. If not quite sweet enough, sweeten now to taste. Then with Dover egg beater, beat violently for five minutes. Now take a pail and place in it this pot of chocolate, carefully covered. Pack around it ice and salt, as you would pack an ice cream freezer. Leave until ice cold, stirring occasionally to avoid crystallization. Pour into a pitcher and serve in glasses.
recipes.method_es: Rompe tres cuartos de libra de Chocolat Menier (envoltorio verde) en un plato hondo grande. Coloca el plato en el horno con la puerta abierta. En poco tiempo se fundira en una pasta lisa que se disolvera con facilidad en la leche. En un cazo de barro al fuego, calienta tres pintas de leche entera. Cuando rompa a hervir, anade poco a poco el chocolate fundido. Deja hervir unos cinco minutos removiendo constantemente con cuchara de madera desde que empiezas a anadir el chocolate. Retira del fuego y, cuando este parcialmente frio, incorpora dos cucharadas de brandy y una pinta de nata previamente montada a punto firme. Si no esta lo bastante dulce, endulza al gusto. Con batidor manual, bate con energia durante cinco minutos. Coloca el cazo bien tapado dentro de un cubo y rodealo de hielo y sal, como una heladora. Deja enfriar hasta que este muy frio, removiendo de vez en cuando para evitar cristalizaciones. Vierte en una jarra y sirve en vasos.
recipes.glassware: jarra de cristal y vaso alto

ingredients.notes: una de las seis tabletas del paquete por taza

recipes.method_original: For each cup allow one of the six tablets into which every package of "Chocolat Menier" is divided (green wrapper preferred). Melt as above directed. Stir this paste into half a cup of boiling milk. When thoroughly dissolved, add half a cup of rich cold milk and allow to boil for about four minutes, stirring constantly from the first with a wooden spoon. Pour into a hot chocolate pot and serve.
recipes.method_es: Por cada taza usa una de las seis tabletas en que se divide el paquete de Chocolat Menier (preferiblemente envoltorio verde). Funde el chocolate como se indica en la receta anterior. Incorpora la pasta a media taza de leche hirviendo. Cuando este completamente disuelta, anade media taza de leche entera fria y deja hervir unos cuatro minutos removiendo desde el principio con cuchara de madera. Vierte en una chocolatera caliente y sirve.
recipes.raw_text:
GOOD CUP OF CHOCOLATE.
For each cup allow one of the         six tablets into

which every package of "Chocolat Menier" is divided
(green wrapper preferred).     Melt as above directed.
Stir this paste into half a cup of boiling milk.   When
thoroughly dissolved, add half a cup of rich cold
milk and allow to boil for about four minutes,       stir-

ring constantly from the first with   a   wooden spoon.
Pour into a hot chocolate pot and serve.


 Qer\eral joules ar\d Remarks
recipes.notes: Chocolate caliente clasico hecho con tabletas Chocolat Menier; servir bien caliente en chocolatera.

ingredients.item_es: caviar (marca Blackwell's), caja de media libra

ingredients.notes: alternando con el limon, gota a gota

recipes.method_original: Take a half pound box of Caviare (Blackwell's), empty it in a soup plate; squeeze over it the juice of a fresh lemon drop by drop alternating with olive oil. Beat well until you have a firm white paste. Pounded almonds may be beaten into the paste if desired. Make according to general directions, omitting butter. This mixture should be spread quite thickly on the bread.
recipes.method_es: Vacia una caja de media libra de caviar Blackwell's en un plato hondo. Anade el zumo de un limon fresco gota a gota, alternando con aceite de oliva tambien gota a gota. Bate bien hasta obtener una pasta firme y blanca. Si lo deseas, incorpora almendras molidas al batir. Monta los sandwiches segun las indicaciones generales, omitiendo la mantequilla. Extiende la mezcla con generosidad sobre el pan.
recipes.raw_text:
CAVIARE SANDWICHES.
Take a half pound box of Caviare (Blackwell's),
empty it in a soup plate; squeeze over it the       juice of

a fresh   lemon drop by drop alternating with olive oil.
Beat well until you have a firm white paste.        Pounded
almonds may be beaten        into the paste    if   desired.

Make according to general directions, omitting but-
ter.    This mixture should be spread quite thickly on
the bread.
recipes.notes: Sandwich de aperitivo, no un coctel; pasta de caviar emulsionada con limon y aceite de oliva, untada generosamente sobre pan sin mantequilla. Acompanamiento clasico para champagne o cocteles del libro.

ingredients.notes: Para lavar las anchoas tras escurrir la salmuera
Para conservar las anchoas dos días en lugar fresco
Cortadas finas según las reglas generales

recipes.method_original: Take a one-half pound box of Italian anchovies, pour off the brine and wash them in vinegar. Keep them in olive oil for two days in a cool place. Drain carefully, open them lengthwise, remove the bones and place between unbuttered slices of bread. With this exception, make as per general rules. These are particularly nice served with Chablis.
recipes.method_es: Tomar una caja de media libra de anchoas italianas, escurrir la salmuera y lavarlas en vinagre. Conservarlas en aceite de oliva durante dos días en un lugar fresco. Escurrir con cuidado, abrirlas a lo largo, retirar las espinas y colocarlas entre rebanadas de pan sin mantequilla. Con esta excepción, preparar según las reglas generales. Resultan especialmente agradables servidos con Chablis.
recipes.raw_text:
ANCHOVIE SANDWICHES AU NATURAL.
Take a one-half pound box of Italian anchovies,

recipes.method_original: Take a pound box of Le Marchand's boneless sardines; remove the sardines carefully, so as not to break them; open each one lengthwise and place the halves on a fine wire broiler; broil quickly on each side; when cold trim off the tails and squeeze a little lemon juice over them. If the unsalted butter is used, it would be well to sprinkle a little salt over the sardines while hot. Allow two halves to each triangle cut and make as per general directions. Sardines can be used without broiling but are not so nice.
recipes.method_es: Tomar una caja de una libra de sardinas sin espinas Le Marchand's; retirar las sardinas con cuidado para no romperlas; abrir cada una a lo largo y colocar las mitades en una parrilla fina de alambre; asarlas rápidamente por cada lado; cuando estén frías, recortar las colas y rociarlas con un poco de jugo de limón. Si se usa mantequilla sin sal, conviene espolvorear un poco de sal sobre las sardinas aún calientes. Reservar dos mitades por cada triángulo cortado y preparar según las indicaciones generales. Pueden usarse sardinas sin asar, pero no quedan tan ricas.

ingredients.notes: Lata grande o pequeña, según las porciones; escurrir el aceite y desmenuzar fino
Pelados y reposados en hielo picado con sal una hora antes de cortar
Para la ensalada de pepino, preparada 45 minutos antes
Untar ambas rebanadas con la pasta de salmón

recipes.method_original: Take a large or small can (according to the number of sandwiches you require) of best Columbia river salmon. Drain from the oil and shred fine. Three-quarters of an hour before needed, prepare a salad of thinly sliced cucumbers with a highly seasoned French dressing and set away on the ice. Proceed with the sandwiches as follows: Take unbuttered slices of bread and spread evenly with the shredded fish. Lift out the cucumber slices with a silver fork, from the dressing, not draining too dry, and place one layer of them between the fish-spread slices. This is an exception to the general rule, in-as-much as both upper and under bread slices are spread with the mixture. Cut according to general directions. The bread spread with the fish may be prepared in advance, but the cucumbers must be added just before serving. It might be well to suggest that cucumbers should always be pared and placed in cracked ice and plenty of salt, one hour before slicing.
recipes.method_es: Tomar una lata grande o pequeña (según el número de sandwiches) del mejor salmón del río Columbia. Escurrir el aceite y desmenuzarlo fino. Tres cuartos de hora antes, preparar una ensalada de pepinos en rodajas finas con una vinagreta francesa bien sazonada y reservarla sobre hielo. Proceder con los sandwiches así: tomar rebanadas de pan sin mantequilla y untarlas uniformemente con el pescado desmenuzado. Sacar las rodajas de pepino del aliño con un tenedor de plata, sin escurrirlas demasiado, y colocar una capa entre las rebanadas untadas con el pescado. Esta es una excepción a la regla general, ya que ambas rebanadas (la de arriba y la de abajo) se untan con la mezcla. Cortar según las indicaciones generales. El pan untado con el pescado puede prepararse con antelación, pero los pepinos deben añadirse justo antes de servir. Conviene recordar que los pepinos siempre deben pelarse y colocarse en hielo picado con bastante sal una hora antes de rebanarlos.

ingredients.notes: La suficiente para formar una pasta espesa y firme
Para colocar entre la mezcla y el pan

ingredients.item_es: Rebanadas de pan untadas con mayonesa

recipes.method_original: Rub smoothly the yolks of six hard-boiled eggs, mixing with them sufficient mayonnaise to form a thick, firm paste. Add salt and pepper if required to season well. Spread the bread very thinly with mayonnaise, then cover with nice white lettuce leaves and place between the lettuce leaves the sandwich mixture. Cut and trim them according to directions, being very particular to press them well together. These must not be made long before serving.
recipes.method_es: Triturar suavemente las yemas de seis huevos duros, mezclándolas con suficiente mayonesa para formar una pasta espesa y firme. Añadir sal y pimienta si hace falta sazonar bien. Untar el pan con una capa muy fina de mayonesa, cubrir con bonitas hojas de lechuga blanca y colocar entre las hojas de lechuga la mezcla del sandwich. Cortarlos y recortarlos según las indicaciones, prestando especial atención a presionarlos bien para que queden compactos. No deben prepararse con mucha antelación al servicio.

obtained.

recipes.raw_text:
CAMEMBERT CHEESE SANDWICHES.
Take a box of good, creamy imported Camem-
bert (not that packed              in        jars)    and spread on the
under buttered bread               slice.            Cover    this   with the
.thin slices of a         Bartlett pear.              Place over this the
top   buttered         slice,   pressing        firmly       together.     Cut
and      serve.        The      excellence            of     this    sandwich
depends entirely on the condition and quality of
the   cheese,      and none but                a      connaisseur        should
select   it.


      All cheese sandwiches are most excellent served

with imported or domestic ales and beers.                            We have
found that a sandwich made of                              " Gluten Entire
Wheat Flour " bread, buttered without any filling, is
very nice with ales or beers and highly relished by
men "who know."
                                        47

        We have given no special receipts for plain beef,
tongue, ham, chicken,         turkey, capon          or    any meat
sandwiches, for     if   made according to general direc-
tions they will each      and all be found appetizing and
acceptable.

        We would say, it is better to sprinkle the season-
ing of pepper and salt on the buttered bread rather

than on the meat, and          all   gristle   and   fat    must be
removed, the meat thinly             sliced   and but one layer
used.

    We would also recommend that Graham bread
be used with all fish sandwiches.

    Never attempt        to   cut sandwiches with           any but
the sharpest of sharp knives.
